title: Velvety Smooth Argentinian Haricot Bean Stew
description: A cultured and silky Argentinian dish featuring haricot beans, perfect for a relaxing brunch, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients and an ice bath shock to preserve nutrients.
instructions: Rinse the haricot beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the beans, then place them in a large pot with enough water to cover them and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and let cook for 45 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
While the beans are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato paste, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Once the beans are cooked, drain them and add them to the skillet with the vegetable mixture.
Stir to combine and let cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly, then transfer it to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Let the stew cool to room temperature, then refrigerate or freeze it for later use.
To serve, reheat the stew over low heat and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
